checkpoint_storage.bound_basis: 128MiB per filter-policy checkpoint, conservatively above observed90.6MB checkpoints plus full-library statistics; actual saved bytes must remain within bound

training_reference_selection: original trajectories only; filter originals before adding their mirrored copies to retained corpus
corpus_scope: BABEL-indexed available public profile; not a claim of reproducing all 12296 author tracking clips or private403 clips
reset_distribution: pinned official pose/velocity/joint reset perturbations retained, four DR events and observation corruption disabled
failure_statistics: pinned EMA alpha0.001/ads_typev1 plus independent cumulative real-attempt counters; initial resets excluded from independent counts
resume_scope: exact saved model/Adam/normalizers/EMA/counters; physics episodes restart, not bit-exact simulator continuation
formal_launch_blockers: remaining GMR cohorts and durable backups
